papers.title: FlexPosit: Tunable Fractional Precision for LLM Inference Accelerators
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer remarkable capabilities but impose prohibitive compute and energy costs. Quantization governs the trade-offs between accuracy and hardware efficiency across granularity and bit-width. Finer granularity (e.g., group-wise) provides high accuracy but incurs scaling and control overhead, while coarser granularity (e.g., channel-wise) has lower overhead but loses accuracy at low precision. Meanwhile, mixed-precision quantization exposes rich accuracy-efficiency trade-offs algorithmically, but existing LLM accelerators remain limited to discrete precision modes, leaving the fractional design space between them unexplored. FlexPosit bridges these gaps through co-design of Posit-based quantization and a precision-tunable bit-serial architecture. Algorithmically, FlexPosit employs distribution-aware quantization with hardware-aligned, sensitivity-guided mixed-precision allocation, leveraging the Posit format's tapered precision to achieve group-wise-like accuracy with channel-wise-like regularity. Architecturally, FlexPosit is a unified bit-serial systolic array with lightweight per-column decoders, unified Processing Elements (PEs), and a global precision controller, enabling tunable fractional precision while preserving fully regular systolic dataflow. Across diverse LLMs, FlexPosit achieves near-FP16 accuracy with sub-5-bit fractional weights. It achieves 1.8x higher throughput and 1.2x lower energy than BitMoD (group-wise quantization), and 1.5x higher throughput and 2.0x lower energy than OliVe (channel-wise quantization), establishing a new Pareto frontier for precision-tunable LLM acceleration.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026)

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 方向重要且思路新颖，但证据完整性仍待加强。
pros: 提出Posit量化与可调分数精度位串行架构协同设计，切中离散精度空白
同时兼顾精度与规则数据流，面向LLM推理效率的工程可实现性较强

papers.title_zh: FlexPosit：LLM 推理加速器的可调分数精度
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 提供卓越的功能，但会带来高昂的计算和能源成本。量化控制着粒度和位宽上的准确性和硬件效率之间的权衡。更细的粒度（例如，按组）提供高精度，但会产生缩放和控制开销，而较粗的粒度（例如，按通道）具有较低的开销，但在低精度时会损失准确性。与此同时，混合精度量化在算法上暴露了丰富的精度与效率权衡，但现有的 LLM 加速器仍然仅限于离散精度模式，从而导致它们之间的分数设计空间尚未探索。 FlexPosit 通过基于 Posit 的量化和精确可调位串行架构的共同设计来弥补这些差距。在算法上，FlexPosit 采用分布感知量化和硬件对齐、灵敏度引导的混合精度分配，利用 Posit 格式的锥形精度来实现类似分组的精度和类似通道的规律性。从架构上讲，FlexPosit 是一个统一的位串行脉动阵列，具有轻量级每列解码器、统一的处理元件 (PE) 和全局精度控制器，可实现可调分数精度，同时保留完全规则的脉动数据流。在不同的法学硕士中，FlexPosit 通过低于 5 位的分数权重实现了接近 FP16 的精度。与 BitMoD（分组量化）相比，它的吞吐量提高了 1.8 倍，能耗降低了 1.2 倍，与 OliVe（通道量化）相比，吞吐量提高了 1.5 倍，能耗降低了 2.0 倍，为精确可调的 LLM 加速建立了新的 Pareto 前沿。

papers.title: CHIPSMORE: Compute-in-Interconnect and -Memory Chiplets for Multi-Mode Multi-Request LLM Inference Acceleration
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) inference exhibits substantial variability across adaptation modes, context lengths, and request concurrency, creating challenges for maintaining high utilization, memory efficiency, and scalable performance on compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerators. This paper presents CHIPSMORE, a multi-mode and multi-request LLM inference accelerator that integrates compute-in-interconnect and CIM to support both base-mode and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) inference under diverse workloads. CHIPSMORE employs heterogeneous processing elements consisting of resistive RAM analog compute-in-memory (RRAM-ACIM) and static RAM digital compute-in-memory (SRAM-DCIM) interconnected through a programmable Inter-PE computational network (IPCN). A composable hierarchical key-value (KV) memory scheme dynamically allocates router scratchpad, SRAM-DCIM, and embedded DRAM (eDRAM) resources according to workload requirements, enabling scalable support for long-context and batched inference. Furthermore, a non-replicated multi-request execution pipeline exploits request-level parallelism without duplicating pretrained weights, while a state-aware resource reconfiguration mechanism selectively retains runtime states and power-gates inactive resources to improve energy efficiency. Evaluation using cycle-accurate hardware-software co-simulation demonstrates that CHIPSMORE effectively sustains high throughput across varying model sizes, context lengths, and batch sizes while maintaining favorable power scaling. Compared with Nvidia H100, CHIPSMORE achieves up to $2.38\times$ higher throughput and $27\times$ higher energy efficiency on Mistral-7B inference while eliminating weight replication for multi-request serving.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 方向重要且设计新颖，但证据链仍偏薄。
pros: 面向多模式与多请求LLM推理，问题定义贴近真实服务场景

papers.title_zh: CHIPSMORE：用于多模式多请求 LLM 推理加速的互连计算和内存芯片
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理在适应模式、上下文长度和请求并发性方面表现出巨大的可变性，从而为维持内存计算 (CIM) 加速器的高利用率、内存效率和可扩展性能带来了挑战。本文介绍了 CHIPSMORE，这是一种多模式和多请求 LLM 推理加速器，它集成了互连计算和 CIM，以支持不同工作负载下的基本模式和低秩自适应 (LoRA) 推理。 CHIPSMORE 采用异构处理元件，包括通过可编程 Inter-PE 计算网络 (IPCN) 互连的电阻 RAM 模拟内存计算 (RRAM-ACIM) 和静态 RAM 数字内存计算 (SRAM-DCIM)。可组合的分层键值 (KV) 内存方案可根据工作负载需求动态分配路由器暂存器、SRAM-DCIM 和嵌入式 DRAM (eDRAM) 资源，从而实现对长上下文和批量推理的可扩展支持。此外，非复制多请求执行管道利用请求级并行性，无需复制预训练权重，而状态感知资源重新配置机制有选择地保留运行时状态和电源门不活动资源以提高能源效率。使用周期精确的硬件-软件联合仿真进行的评估表明，CHIPSMORE 在不同的模型大小、上下文长度和批量大小上有效维持高吞吐量，同时保持有利的功率缩放。与 Nvidia H100 相比，CHIPSMORE 在 Mistral-7B 推理上实现了高达 2.38 倍的吞吐量提升和 27 倍的能效提升，同时消除了多请求服务的权重复制。

papers.title: CateKV: On Sequential Consistency for Long-Context LLM Inference Acceleration
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in handling long-context tasks, but processing such long contexts remains challenging due to the substantial memory requirements and inference latency. In this work, we discover that certain attention heads exhibit sequential consistency in their attention patterns, which can be persistently identified using a coefficient-of-variation-based algorithm. Inspired by this observation, we propose CateKV, a hybrid KV cache method that retains only critical token information for consistent heads, thereby reducing KV cache size and computational overhead, while preserving the majority of KV pairs in adaptive heads to ensure high accuracy. We show the unique characteristics of our algorithm and its extension with existing acceleration methods. Comprehensive evaluations on long-context benchmarks show that, while maintaining accuracy comparable to full attention, CateKV reduces memory usage by up to $2.72\times$ and accelerates decoding by $2.18\times$ in single-sample inputs, and boosts throughput by $3.96\times$ in batch scenarios.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), PMLR 267:27569-27585, 2025

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路务实且有效，但创新与证据强度中等。
pros: 抓住注意力头序列一致性这一可利用结构，方法动机清晰
在精度基本保持下同时提升显存、时延与批处理吞吐，应用价值较高

papers.title_zh: CateKV：论长上下文 LLM 推理加速的顺序一致性
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在处理长上下文任务方面表现出了强大的能力，但由于大量的内存需求和推理延迟，处理如此长的上下文仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们发现某些注意力头在其注意力模式中表现出顺序一致性，这可以使用基于变异系数的算法持续识别。受这一观察的启发，我们提出了 CateKV，一种混合​​ KV 缓存方法，仅保留一致头的关键令牌信息，从而减少 KV 缓存大小和计算开销，同时保留自适应头中的大部分 KV 对以确保高精度。我们展示了我们的算法的独特特征及其对现有加速方法的扩展。对长上下文基准的综合评估表明，在保持与完全注意力相当的准确性的同时，CateKV 在单样本输入中将内存使用量减少了高达 $2.72\times$，并将解码速度提高了 $2.18\times$，并在批处理场景中将吞吐量提高了 $3.96\times$。

papers.title: FLINT: Efficiently Leveraging High Bandwidth Flash for Capacity-Scalable LLM Inference Acceleration
papers.summary: LLM inference is increasingly constrained by accelerator memory capacity rather than compute throughput. This constraint is especially acute in single-accelerator and small-node inference systems, where limited on-package memory capacity restricts the size of deployable models. HBF is an emerging 3D-stacked NAND flash technology that provides multi-terabyte near-accelerator capacity, making it a promising capacity tier for storing LLM weights. However, existing HBF-based proposals face three adoption challenges: they (1) rely on coarse-grained static prefetching for LLM weights aiming to hide the microsecond-level read latency of the NAND flash device while maximizing HBF's read throughput, (2) expose NAND flash management tasks (e.g., refresh operations) to the accelerator-visible critical inference path, and (3) miss optimization opportunities to specialize and optimize the flash-management mechanisms to the workload behavior. Our goal is to design an efficient HBF substrate that integrates HBF as a memory-capacity tier alongside HBM while addressing these three challenges. To this end, we propose FLINT, a workload-driven HBF substrate for capacity-scalable LLM inference. FLINT introduces three mechanisms: (1) a hardware burst-buffer controller that dynamically coalesces and pipelines HBF reads aiming to utilize existing NAND flash buffers while sustaining high HBF bandwidth, (2) a phantom-plane refresh mechanism, which removes refresh from the critical inference path by moving refresh-related NAND flash operations outside the read foreground back via low-cost resource duplication, and (3) a read-only FTL, which replaces SSD-class support for arbitrary writes with a compact table that translates logical weight bursts to physical HBF locations.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、设计完整，但证据强度仍待实证支撑。
pros: 聚焦小规模节点LLM推理容量瓶颈，选题契合产业痛点且有现实意义

cons: 摘要未给出关键定量结果与对比边界，难判断真实收益、开销与泛化性

papers.title_zh: FLINT：有效利用高带宽闪存实现容量可扩展的 LLM 推理加速
papers.summary_zh: LLM 推理越来越受到加速器内存容量而非计算吞吐量的限制。这种限制在单加速器和小节点推理系统中尤其严重，其中有限的封装内存容量限制了可部署模型的大小。 HBF 是一种新兴的 3D 堆叠 NAND 闪存技术，可提供数 TB 的近加速器容量，使其成为存储 LLM 权重的有前景的容量层。然而，现有的基于 HBF 的提案面临三个采用挑战：(1) 依赖于 LLM 权重的粗粒度静态预取，旨在隐藏 NAND 闪存设备的微秒级读取延迟，同时最大化 HBF 的读取吞吐量；(2) 将 NAND 闪存管理任务（例如刷新操作）暴露给加速器可见的关键推理路径；(3) 错过针对工作负载行为专门化和优化闪存管理机制的优化机会。我们的目标是设计一种高效的 HBF 基板，将 HBF 作为内存容量层与 HBM 集成，同时解决这三个挑战。为此，我们提出了 FLINT，一种工作负载驱动的 HBF 基底，用于容量可扩展的 LLM 推理。 FLINT 引入了三种机制：(1) 硬件突发缓冲区控制器，动态合并和管道化 HBF 读取，旨在利用现有 NAND 闪存缓冲区，同时维持高 HBF 带宽；(2) 幻像平面刷新机制，通过低成本资源复制将与刷新相关的 NAND 闪存操作移回读取前台，从而从关键推理路径中删除刷新；(3) 只读 FTL，用紧凑型文件替换对任意写入的 SSD 级支持。将逻辑权重突发转换为物理 HBF 位置的表。

papers.title: TileMix: Tile-Centric Mixed-Precision Attention for LLM Inference Acceleration
papers.summary: Long-context prefill in large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory traffic because dense self-attention computes quadratic query-key scores. Existing methods either use a uniform low-precision path or select token interactions, leaving spatial precision routing over hardware-aligned score tiles outside fused dense attention. We introduce TileMix, a tile-centric precision-routing kernel that makes numerical precision an executable spatial decision over score-tile groups within fused dense attention. TileMix partitions the attention matrix into hardware-aligned score tiles, packs routing decisions into compact bitmasks, and dispatches each tile group through FP16 or INT8 score computation while both paths update a shared online-softmax state. Scalable precision grouping lets each routing bit govern multiple adjacent key tiles, preserving hardware-aligned compute tiles and compact metadata at long contexts. By routing all legal tile groups, TileMix preserves dense token connectivity, requires no training, and supports grouped-query attention, variable-length batches, and INT8 key/value caches. Across LongEval, LV-Eval, and A100 prefill benchmarks on LLaMA, Qwen, and Vicuna, TileMix recovers long-context quality lost under uniform INT8 and improves prefill throughput over FP16, yielding a controllable accuracy-efficiency frontier across model families. The implementation is available at https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/TileMix.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路有新意且实用，但证据链仍需加强。
pros: 提出按硬件对齐score tile进行空间精度路由，较统一低精度更细粒度
保持稠密注意力连通且免训练，兼容GQA、变长batch与INT8 KV缓存
cons: 摘要未充分说明路由开销、极端长上下文稳定性及跨硬件泛化，严谨性仍有限

papers.title_zh: TileMix：以 Tile 为中心的混合精度注意力，用于 LLM 推理加速
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 中的长上下文预填充会产生大量计算和内存流量，因为密集的自注意力会计算二次查询键分数。现有方法要么使用统一的低精度路径，要么选择令牌交互，将硬件对齐分数块上的空间精度路由置于融合密集注意力之外。我们引入了 TileMix，一个以图块为中心的精确路由内核，它使数值精度成为融合密集注意力内分数图块组的可执行空间决策。 TileMix 将注意力矩阵划分为硬件对齐的分数图块，将路由决策打包为紧凑的位掩码，并通过 FP16 或 INT8 分数计算调度每个图块组，同时两条路径更新共享的在线 softmax 状态。可扩展的精确分组使每个路由位能够管理多个相邻的关键切片，从而在长上下文中保留硬件对齐的计算切片和紧凑的元数据。通过路由所有合法的图块组，TileMix 保留了密集的令牌连接，无需训练，并支持分组查询注意力、可变长度批次和 INT8 键/值缓存。在 LLaMA、Qwen 和 Vicuna 上的 LongEval、LV-Eval 和 A100 预填充基准测试中，TileMix 恢复了统一 INT8 下丢失的长上下文质量，并提高了 FP16 上的预填充吞吐量，从而在模型系列中产生了可控的精度-效率前沿。该实现可在 https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/TileMix 上找到。
